entities.name: RRC Connection Re-establishment
entities.description: Procedure to re-establish the RRC connection for a UE in RRC_CONNECTED state with active AS security and established SRB2 and at least one DRB/multicast MRB (or SRB2 for IAB).

entities.name: RRCReestablishmentRequest
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

entities.name: RRCReestablishment
entities.description: Message sent by network in response to RRCReestablishmentRequest when UE context is verified.

entities.name: RRCReestablishmentComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete the RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

entities.name: RRCSetup
entities.description: Message sent by network when UE context cannot be retrieved, initiating fallback to new RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active RRC connection.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE does not have an active RRC connection.

entities.name: AS security activated
entities.description: Condition where AS security has been activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB/multicast MRB setup (or SRB2 for IAB).

entities.name: UE context verified
entities.description: Condition where network is able to find and verify a valid UE context.

entities.name: UE context not retrieved
entities.description: Condition where network cannot retrieve or verify UE context.

entities.name: Re-activate AS security
entities.description: Network action to re-activate AS security without changing algorithms.

entities.name: Re-establish and resume SRB1
entities.description: Network action to re-establish and resume SRB1 during connection re-establishment.

entities.name: Discard stored AS Context
entities.description: Network action to discard stored AS Context and release all RBs and BH RLC channels and Uu Relay RLC channels when UE context cannot be retrieved.

relations.description: Procedure initiation step where UE sends RRCReestablishmentRequest message.
Procedure step where network responds with RRCReestablishment message.
Procedure completion step where UE sends RRCReestablishmentComplete message.
Procedure requires AS security to be activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB/multicast MRB setup.
Procedure can only be initiated when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
When UE context is verified, network re-activates AS security without changing algorithms.
When UE context is verified, network re-establishes and resumes SRB1.
When UE context cannot be retrieved, network discards stored AS Context and releases all RBs and channels.
When UE context cannot be retrieved, network falls back to RRCSetup message to establish new RRC connection.
If AS security has not been activated, UE moves to RRC_IDLE directly with release cause 'other'.
